usage: The word 音樂 (jam1 ngok6) is a noun, referring to music as a form of art or entertainment.
You can use 音樂 to talk about different genres, like classical or pop music.
When describing what type of 音樂 you like, you can put adjectives before it, like 好嘅音樂 (good music).
音樂 can also be used as part of compound words like 音樂會 (music concert).
It is common to use the verb 聽 (to listen) with 音樂, e.g., 聽音樂.
